title: Expert Pet Grooming Services in Boston | MSPCA-Angell

facts.fact: The MSPCA-Angell Boston grooming appointments are available Monday through Friday, 8:30am to 3:30pm.
Grooming services are available only to dogs and cats that have established care with one of the MSPCA-Angell's non-emergency veterinarians within the past year.
facts.quote: Our grooming services are available to dogs and cats that have established care with one of our non-emergency veterinarians within the past year.

facts.fact: Dogs must be current on rabies and DHPP vaccines to receive grooming, and puppies under 16 weeks old must be up to date on all vaccines based on age requirement.
facts.quote: Dogs — Rabies and DHPP (puppies under 16 weeks old must be up to date on all vaccines based on age requirement)

facts.fact: Cats must be current on rabies and FVRCP vaccines to receive grooming at the MSPCA-Angell Boston location.
All pets must be able to stand for the full length of a grooming appointment, which is approximately 2 hours.
facts.quote: **All pets must be able to stand** for the full length of a grooming appointment (approximately 2 hours).

facts.fact: The MSPCA-Angell Boston grooming salon is located in the Healthy Boarding ward, separate from the Medical wards.
facts.quote: Our grooming salon is located in our Healthy Boarding ward, an exclusive area separate from our Medical wards.

facts.fact: The MSPCA-Angell groomer Charlotte Gale is Fear-Free Certified.
facts.quote: Our talented groomer, Charlotte Gale, is Fear-Free Certified

facts.fact: The MSPCA-Angell Boston grooming service lists full-service bathing, partial and full haircuts, deshedding treatments, toothbrushing, nail trimming, ear cleaning, and hypoallergenic shampoos for dogs and cats.
facts.quote: Full-service pet bathing Partial and full haircuts for dogs and cats Deshedding treatments Toothbrushing Nail trimming Ear cleaning

facts.fact: Bathing and grooming options are offered during boarding stays at the MSPCA-Angell Boston location.
facts.quote: Bathing and grooming options offered during boarding stays for your convenience

facts.fact: The MSPCA-Angell Boston grooming salon is at 350 South Huntington Ave, Boston, MA 02130, with phone 617-541-5082.
